name: AppSecret
description: Per-app secret store. Holds the application's own integration credentials (third-party API keys, OAuth client secrets, SMTP credentials, etc.) addressable by name. App admins manage these via the app-admin UI; functions reach them indirectly through ctx.service(). Distinct from Secret (platform-level, tenant 0 only) — see plan-52.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Lookup key (e.g., STRIPE_API_KEY, SENDGRID_API_KEY). createOnly — rename is not allowed; create a new row and delete the old one if you must change the key name.

attributes.name: encryptedValue
attributes.description: AES-256-GCM encrypted value. Never stored or returned in plaintext via generic CRUD; plaintext access only through the decryption service called from server-side function code.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Human-readable note describing what this secret is for
